description: Create a Logpush job streaming a dataset to a destination. Requires confirm:true (human-approval gate); without it returns a preview only.

account_id.description: Create an account-scoped job (used when zone_id is omitted).

confirm.description: Human-approval gate: must be true to actually perform this mutating operation. Omit or set false to get a non-executing preview of what would happen (with secrets redacted). A human should approve before this is set to true.

destination_conf.description: Destination URI, e.g. s3://bucket/path?region=us-east-1 or r2://... or an HTTPS endpoint.

enabled.description: Whether the job starts enabled. Default true.

zone_id.description: The Cloudflare zone ID (32-char hex). Get it from list_zones.

name: create_logpush_job
